answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 150319 Country: India Title: Is it permissible to eat Easter Eggs? Question: Is it permissible to eat Easter Eggs? Answer ID: 150319 Posted on: May 15, 2023 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 948/917/SN=8/1438) Eid al-Fash is the religious festival of Christians wherein the egg is decorated and presented under a special belief; thus if this egg is of any halal bird yet it should not be eaten. (For details see: Al-Fatawa al-Kubra, for Ibn Taymiya, Fatawa al-Azhar, etc.) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
